name: Modafinil
description: A wakefulness-promoting agent approved for excessive sleepiness in narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnoea and shift-work disorder. A Schedule IV controlled substance.

systems.note: Wakefulness promotion is the labelled indication.
Hepatically metabolised with CYP3A4 induction; transaminase elevation is reported.
Blood pressure and heart rate elevation are labelled.

monitors.why: Reported transaminase elevation and heavy hepatic metabolism.
Wakefulness agents alter mood and affect alongside alertness.
